title: The Laws of Exponents
summary: Multiply, divide and raise powers to powers, and understand why the laws work.

ib.note: Laws of exponents are MYP 3 Algebra/Number

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 10: Exponents and Powers

objectives: I can use the laws of exponents to simplify expressions.
I can explain each law by writing powers out in full.
I can spot when the laws do not apply (different bases).
